title: UiPath Orchestrator Entities
description: JSON Schema for core UiPath Orchestrator entities including jobs, queues, queue items, assets, processes, robots, and webhooks used in the automation management platform.

Job.title: Orchestrator Job
Job.description: Represents a single automation job execution instance in UiPath Orchestrator.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the job assigned by Orchestrator

Key.description: Unique GUID key for the job, used for external references

ReleaseName.description: Name of the process (release) that this job executes

ProcessVersion.description: Semantic version of the process package used in this job execution

State.description: Current execution state of the job lifecycle

Source.description: How the job was initiated; Manual by a user, Schedule by a trigger, Queue by a queue transaction

StartTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the robot began executing the job

EndTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when job execution completed or was terminated

CreationTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was created and queued

Info.description: Human-readable information message, including error details for faulted jobs

HostMachineName.description: Hostname of the machine on which the robot executed the job

Robot.description: Reference to the robot that executed or is executing this job

OrganizationUnitId.description: Numeric ID of the Orchestrator folder in which this job resides

InputArguments.description: JSON-serialized input arguments passed to the process on job start

OutputArguments.description: JSON-serialized output arguments returned by the process upon successful completion

JobPriority.description: Priority level used when the job was queued for execution

RobotRef.title: Robot Reference
RobotRef.description: A lightweight reference to a UiPath robot associated with a job or queue transaction.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the robot

Name.description: Display name of the robot as configured in Orchestrator

MachineName.description: Hostname of the machine the robot is registered on

MachineId.description: Unique integer identifier of the machine

Version.description: Version of the UiPath Robot software installed on the machine

UserName.description: Windows or Linux operating system username that the robot runs under

QueueDefinition.title: Queue Definition
QueueDefinition.description: Definition of a named transaction queue used for distributing work items to robots in Orchestrator.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the queue definition

Name.description: Display name of the queue used when referencing it from robot activities

Description.description: Optional description of the queue's business purpose

MaxNumberOfRetries.description: Maximum number of times a failed transaction item will be automatically retried

AcceptAutomaticallyRetry.description: Whether failed items with remaining retries are automatically re-queued

EnforceUniqueReference.description: Whether each item in this queue must have a unique reference string

OrganizationUnitId.description: Numeric ID of the Orchestrator folder in which this queue is defined

QueueItem.title: Queue Item
QueueItem.description: A single transaction item in an Orchestrator queue, representing a unit of work to be processed by a robot.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the queue item

Key.description: Unique GUID key for the queue item used in robot activities

QueueDefinitionId.description: ID of the queue definition this item belongs to

Status.description: Current processing status of the queue item

ReviewStatus.description: Manual review status applied to failed items in the Orchestrator interface

Priority.description: Processing priority of the queue item affecting robot pickup order

Reference.description: Optional unique reference string for idempotent item identification

SpecificContent.description: Custom key-value business payload data associated with this queue item

Output.description: Output data written by the robot after successfully processing the item

CreationTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the item was added to the queue

StartProcessing.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when a robot began processing this item

EndProcessing.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when robot processing of this item ended

RetryNumber.description: Number of times this item has been retried after failure

DueDate.description: Optional deadline by which the item must be processed

PostponeDate.description: Optional earliest time at which the item may be picked up for processing

Robot.description: Reference to the robot that processed or is processing this item

Asset.title: Orchestrator Asset
Asset.description: A shared asset in Orchestrator that stores a named value accessible to automation processes at runtime.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the asset

Name.description: Display name of the asset used by robot activities to look it up

ValueType.description: Data type of the value stored in this asset

StringValue.description: Text value of the asset when ValueType is Text

IntValue.description: Integer value of the asset when ValueType is Integer

BoolValue.description: Boolean value of the asset when ValueType is Bool

CredentialUsername.description: Username portion of the credential when ValueType is Credential

CredentialPassword.description: Password portion of the credential when ValueType is Credential; write-only, never returned in responses

Description.description: Optional description of the asset's purpose and contents

OrganizationUnitId.description: Numeric ID of the Orchestrator folder in which this asset is defined

Webhook.title: Orchestrator Webhook
Webhook.description: A webhook subscription in Orchestrator that delivers HTTP POST event notifications to a configured URL.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the webhook subscription

Url.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL that receives event POST requests from Orchestrator

Enabled.description: Whether the webhook subscription is active and sending event notifications

Secret.description: Optional secret used to compute the HMAC-SHA256 payload signature delivered in X-UiPath-Signature header

SubscribeToAllEvents.description: When true, the webhook receives all available event types without filtering

AllowInsecureSsl.description: Whether to allow delivery to endpoints with invalid or self-signed SSL certificates

Events.description: List of specific event type identifiers to subscribe to when SubscribeToAllEvents is false

Process.title: Orchestrator Process
Process.description: An automation process deployed in an Orchestrator folder, representing a specific package version configured for execution.

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the process

Key.description: Unique GUID key for the process, used in job start requests

Name.description: Display name of the process as shown in Orchestrator

Description.description: Optional description of the process's purpose

ProcessVersion.description: Semantic version of the underlying package this process is pinned to

OrganizationUnitId.description: Numeric ID of the Orchestrator folder where this process is deployed
